checks.proves: Partner financial presentation and DSH/WLT application boundary consumers are explicitly mapped.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not prove ledger balance, authorization or reconciliation runtime behavior.
checks.passCriteria: Every Partner financial display/mutation resolves to the governed WLT boundary and no frontend/DSH authoritative calculation is found.
checks.failCriteria: Local financial truth, caller-authoritative amount or unbounded financial mutation is found.

checks.proves: WLT backend compiles and its Go tests pass after Partner finance changes.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not by itself prove DSH proxy/mobile runtime or representative database migration path.

checks.proves: Registered WLT migration/invariant probes including financial database constraints execute on the supported local runtime.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not grant finance approval or prove production/provider reconciliation.
checks.passCriteria: Probe exits zero with no financial invariant or migration drift failure.
checks.failCriteria: Any WLT migration, ledger, custody or invariant probe fails.

checks.proves: Partner finance/COD application-facing readback is exercised with the same Partner runtime candidate where covered by the script.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not substitute for independent finance approval or production/provider evidence.
checks.passCriteria: Partner financial reads are scoped and COD mutation/readback does not fabricate success or bypass reconciliation.
checks.failCriteria: Any actor-scope, mutation, reconciliation or canonical-readback assertion fails.
